summary: This directory serves as the root container for the project's source code, organizing the fundamental domain logic, service layers, and infrastructure components required to execute the application's core business processes.
responsibilities: Manage external data persistence and communication
Provide public interfaces for application services
relationships: Application services consume domain models to execute business rules.
Infrastructure components provide the necessary data access for application services.
Domain models remain isolated from infrastructure details to ensure portability.
designDecisions: Separation of concerns between business logic and infrastructure
